summary: Programmatic rollups of fragmented, high-cash-flow service niches, sourced off-market from family-owned and founder-led businesses, held with permanent capital.
pillars: Rollup power law: back platforms with a long reinvestment runway; target $30M+ EBITDA within 4-6 years, then hold or sell
Alpha from friction-heavy, proprietary sourcing; avoid banker-run auctions and easily searched directories
Permanent capital: no forced exit; reinvest cash flow
Sector-agnostic, tech-enabled sub-holding platforms in fragmented service niches (e.g. franchise networks, locksmith and access control)
